The spec also measures calibration, which can move B14 (working) with our own data. The only source is one study by a vendor's customer on customer-service traces, and its human audit was inconclusive. So the spec sizes the human audit from B21 (300 test traces, at least 75 failures), raises the cost to M for about 10 people-days of labelling, and requires an egress review before any trace leaves our infrastructure.
